name: HYDRA-UMC-OPCUA-SERVER
notes: Real OPC-UA address space, verified with a real OPCUAClient session over the real binary protocol (browse, read, write). Real, explicit, versioned namespace URI and stable string NodeIds; a real quality/units/UTC-timestamped DataItem (SpindleTemp, real EngineeringUnits); real per-session read/write authorization on MaintenanceMode (anonymous read-only, authenticated write via OPCUA_ADMIN_USERNAME/PASSWORD). Every real session now requires Sign/SignAndEncrypt with a real security policy (Basic256Sha256/Aes128_Sha256_RsaOaep/Aes256_Sha256_RsaPss) - a real SecurityPolicy.None connection is genuinely refused, closing a real gap where node-opcua's own unconfigured defaults still exposed one; OPCUA_ALLOW_INSECURE=1 is an explicit, off-by-default local-dev escape hatch, verified with a real protocol-level test proving both the refusal and the escape hatch actually work.
